scripts.emulators:all: pnpm --filter @paper-baker/functions build && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" PAPERBAKER_WEB_URL="http://localhost:5173" firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting --project paper-baker
scripts.emulators:e2e: pnpm --filter @paper-baker/functions build && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:start --config firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project paper-baker
scripts.test:rules: PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore --project paper-baker 'vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts'
scripts.test:functions: PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore --project paper-baker 'vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.ts'
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --filter @paper-baker/functions build && pnpm --filter @paper-baker/web build && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/bin:$PATH" PAPERBAKER_WEB_URL="http://localhost:5173" PAPERBAKER_HOSTING_URL="http://127.0.0.1:5150" firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore,functions,hosting --project paper-baker 'vitest run --config vitest.smoke.config.ts'
